story_type: cargo ship slamming into heavy seas far offshore, helicopter hoists two hurt crewmen
hook: A 728 foot ship in 19 foot seas. Two men aboard were hurt.
narration: This seven hundred and twenty-eight foot cargo ship was burying its bow in nineteen foot seas.
Two hundred and twenty miles southeast of Kodiak, Alaska, two of its crewmen had been hurt in falls during the heavy weather.
That was too far out to wait. The ship turned toward Kodiak Island to close the distance.
A Jayhawk helicopter and a Hercules plane launched from Kodiak to meet it.
A loaded cargo ship cannot stop for a hoist. The pilot flies alongside at the same speed while the hoist operator watches the deck rise and fall.
[short pause] And the whole time, the bow kept plowing into the seas.
outcome: The Jayhawk crew hoisted both men off the ship and flew them back to Kodiak.
title: 728 foot ship in 19 foot seas
description:
On Feb. 9, 2016, a Coast Guard Air Station Kodiak MH-60 Jayhawk crew hoisted two injured crewmen from the 728-foot cargo ship Cemtex Venture in heavy seas about 220 miles southeast of Kodiak, Alaska.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, Air Station Kodiak, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/449390/coast-guard-medevacs-2-injured-crewmen-220-miles-southeast-kodiak-alaska
